Thanks again for taking time this morning, Tom & Sara — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the engineering workshop on the calendar:

- Goal: validate inference path for Peregrine’s 'Perception' model in prod (latency 80ms p95, cost targets, and isolation needs).
- Primary success criteria: reproduce a 1k-req/sec demo, confirm KV cache behavior for multi-tenant workloads, and list any data flow logging requirements.

Suggested next step: 60-90 minute technical runthrough with our ML infra engineers and your infra/model leads. We’ll walk architecture, run a small live load test, and outline the mutual action plan.

Proposed slots (all PST):
1) Tue Jun 3, 10:00–11:30
2) Wed Jun 4, 13:00–14:30
3) Thu Jun 5, 08:30–10:00

Proposed attendee matrix:
- Peregrine: Tom (platform), Sara (ML lead), one infra/ops engineer (preferably the person who owns deployment).
- Redwood: Laura (AM), Ben (solutions), Marcus (serving runtime lead).

Please reply with preferred slot (or share a calendar link) and any other people who should join. I attached a short mutual action plan and a 1-page infra deck so your procurement/security folks have an initial artifact.

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf, redwood-infra-deck.pdf

Thanks — Laura
